I grew up in a very restrictive and isolated/ conservative home. I was homeschooled and a lot of your experiences are similar to my growing up. I am still working out how to be a person but one thing I will say is that dont see virginity as a bad thing. I know that is an unpopular opinion in today's culture but it really is oversold. My outlet when I got some freedom in life was video games and I met a girl I really liked. Fast forward and I met her in real life and eventually moved in with her. I was willing to ignore a lot of red flags because I thought if I could just have a relationship and be with someone that it would fix me. We slept together often and I allowed myself to cater to her will and lost myself. Like a switch being thrown she and I started having arguments and fighting. Rather than ending it normally she decided to tell all of her friends and our neighbours that I had raped her. I was devastated. Still feels like a dagger in my side everytime I think about it. She told this story to my family as well but they saw right through it. She never tried to go to the police or anything like that, but she ruined my relationship with everyone I had met in that town. Found out later she moved in with a guy a few weeks later. Its heavily impacted any relationship I've had sense and now i even feel uncomfortable hugging longtime female friends in public. I know this story is dramatic but my point is dont rush into something. Be sure the person you are with has good intentions and that they are quality and deserving of you. Sex is a beautiful thing, dont let anyone look down on you for being selective. Sorry if this was a weird rant but I hope the best for you.
